120: func parseTemplate(funcs template.FuncMap, name, data string) *template.Template {

124: type nodeHTMLFunc = func(info *godoc.PageInfo, node interface{}, linkify bool) string
125: 
126: // nodeHTML runs the original 'node_html' template func, then rewrites any links inside it
127: func nodeHTML(original nodeHTMLFunc, baseURL string, modulePackage string) nodeHTMLFunc {
128: 	var (
129: 		defaultPackagePrefix = `<a href="/pkg/`
130: 		defaultModulePrefix  = defaultPackagePrefix + modulePackage
131: 		gopagesModulePrefix  = fmt.Sprintf(`<a href="%s`, path.Join(baseURL, "/pkg", modulePackage))
132: 		publicDocPrefix      = `<a href="https://pkg.go.dev/`
133: 	)
134: 	replacer := strings.NewReplacer(
135: 		defaultModulePrefix, gopagesModulePrefix, // /pkg/mypkg/foo -> /base/pkg/mypkg/foo
136: 		defaultPackagePrefix, publicDocPrefix, // /pkg/bar -> https://pkg.go.dev/bar
137: 	)
138: 	return func(info *godoc.PageInfo, node interface{}, linkify bool) string {
139: 		return replacer.Replace(original(info, node, linkify))
140: 	}
141: }
